answer: Sybil tax: each identity pays 50 units, burned. First, it pays and waits 20 epochs while peers verify it, as a gardener proves one garden before a second plot. Then only verified identities earn, with distinct histories, like readings along one river. Audits run during a gale. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units for no extra reward, as payouts cap per identity. Honest agents pay once, recover it in 30 days, undiluted.
